citation: Act of Aug. 10, 1917, ch. 53, sec. 24, 40 Stat. 276, 283 (Lever Act)
note: Termination section (provisions cease when the war with Germany terminated; fact and date to be proclaimed by the President); basis of branch B13 (4 members) and candidate end for B13X. Read on the web only.

citation: Act of May 20, 1918, ch. 78, 40 Stat. 556-557 (Overman Act)
note: Duration proviso (p. 556) and termination paragraph reaching 'any authorization of the President under this Act' (p. 557); basis of B15 (3 members), candidate end for B15X and B16 (the PDF covers pp. 556-557).

citation: Act of June 15, 1917, ch. 29, emergency shipping fund, 40 Stat. 182, 183
note: 'All authority granted to the President herein, or by him delegated, shall cease six months after a final treaty of peace is proclaimed'; basis of B14 (2 members), candidate end for B14X, B13X and EO 2687.

citation: Act of Apr. 22, 1918, ch. 62, 40 Stat. 535 (amending the emergency shipping fund provisions of the Act of June 15, 1917)
note: Amends the 1917 section 'by adding a new provision' and adds words to its paragraph (b); no termination of its own. EO 2888's only authority (B14). Read on the web 2026-11-06; first page of the chapter as served by the link service.

citation: Urgent Deficiency Appropriation Act of Oct. 6, 1917, 'Emergency shipping fund' section (40 Stat., page unverified)
note: Raises the cost limits of the 1917 authority; needed for B14X (EO 3018, 3064). Page as served by the link service not verified.

citation: Sundry Civil Appropriation Act of July 1, 1918, 'Emergency shipping fund' section (40 Stat. 634 as cited in EO 3248-A for the Act; section page unverified)
note: Not yet read; decides whether the powers EO 3018 delegates under it fall within the 1917 cessation sentence's 'herein' (B14X).

citation: First Deficiency Appropriation Act, 1919, Act of Nov. 4, 1918, 'Emergency shipping fund' section (page unverified)
note: Not yet read; same question as the July 1, 1918 section for EO 3018 and 3064 (B14X). The page 1020 is a lead to verify, not a verified citation.

citation: Act of June 19, 1912, ch. 174, sec. 2, 37 Stat. 137, 138 (eight-hour law)
note: Waiver power 'during time of war or a time when war is imminent'; authority of EO 2663 and part of EO 2678 (B20). Read on the web 2026-11-06.

citation: Treaty of peace with Germany, signed Aug. 25, 1921, proclaimed Nov. 14, 1921, 42 Stat. 1939
note: Proclamation date fixes the emergency shipping fund end (May 14, 1922) and bounds the Overman Act and war-keyed own terms (B06, B14, B15, B17); would date EO 3019-A's 'proclamation of peace' cap (B15X, B16).

citation: Treaty of peace with Hungary, signed Aug. 29, 1921, proclaimed Dec. 20, 1921, 42 Stat. 1951
note: Latest 1921 treaty proclamation; upper bound (June 20, 1922) for the Overman Act and EO 2929, and Dec. 20, 1921 for EO 2652.

citation: Joint Resolution of July 2, 1921, ch. 40, 42 Stat. 105-107 (Knox-Porter Resolution)
note: Declares the state of war at an end (secs. 1, 3) and retains enemy property (sec. 5); context for EO 2652 and the alien-property branch.

citation: National Archives, Guide to Federal Records, RG 63 (Committee on Public Information), administrative history
note: Reads 'Abolished: By EO 3154, August 21, 1919'; restates the order's date and does not record the transfer EO 3154 made its condition. B09 (4 members) needs the Council of National Defense or Committee liquidation records of the transfer itself.

citation: National Archives, Guide to Federal Records, RG 182 (War Trade Board), administrative history
note: Board abolished effective June 30, 1919 under EOs 3059 and 3086-A as amended by EO 3099; candidate earlier end for B15 (EO 3059, 3086-A), B11 and EO 2729-A's War Trade Board part (B19).

citation: National Archives, Guide to Federal Records, RG 131 (Office of Alien Property), administrative history
note: EO 9095 created the 1942 Custodian's office; EO 9142 (Apr. 21, 1942) gave it the Alien Property Division's functions; EO 9788 and EO 11281 ended the offices. Context for M12 (B18, B19). The texts of EO 9142 and EO 6694 are also not held.

citation: Executive Order 11281 of May 13, 1966, 31 FR 7215
note: Recites the Office of Alien Property's abolition by June 30, 1966; context showing no instrument ends WWI sale authorizations.

citation: Alien Property Custodian Report: proceedings under the Trading with the Enemy Act during 1918 and to Feb. 15, 1919 (1919)
note: Sale and rejection records for the 1918-1919 sale orders (B18, 153 members; also the exact date of the EO 3259 sale and the EO 3183 rejection). The Custodian's annual reports for 1919-1934 are needed for the 1920s orders: search HathiTrust for 'Annual report of the Alien Property Custodian'.

citation: 50 U.S.C. 4312 (Trading with the Enemy Act sec. 12), with the Act of Oct. 6, 1917, ch. 106, 40 Stat. 411 and the Act of Mar. 28, 1918 amendment
note: Current sec. 12 and its history: confirms the sale authority survives and no statute ended unexercised sale authorizations (B18, B19).

citation: Act of Mar. 4, 1917, ch. 180, eight-hour suspension proviso, 39 Stat. 1192
note: Authority for the eight-hour suspensions (B20); 'in case of national emergency'. Whether 41 Stat. 1359 reaches it is unsettled.

citation: Settlement of War Claims Act of 1928, Act of Mar. 10, 1928, ch. 167, 45 Stat. 254
note: Return of vested property to former owners; needed to show which unexercised sale authorizations became moot (B18). Citation as commonly given; page unverified until fetched.

citation: Public Land Order 369 of May 15, 1947, 12 FR 2038 (Alaska; revoking EO Nos. 2247, 2658 and 3923)
note: The PLO's own text is needed to identify which order its '3923' means: the census EO 3923 is an Alien Property Custodian sale (B18), so the BLM table entry is a number collision. The FR issue URL was not found (the govinfo FR link service did not resolve 12 FR 2038).

citation: Executive Order 2687-A of Aug. 21, 1917 (an official printing is preferred; the Wikisource page is a lead)
note: A Wikisource editor's note says it superseded EO 2645 (B99) and that EO 2729-A revoked it; its own words must be read under P3 before EO 2645 can be decided.
